generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: stems 1 to 1.5 m long, usually shorter, swollen below ground; leaves 78 to 97 cm long, the petiole 10 to 27 cm; leaflets in 86 to 107 pairs, 8 to 11 cm by 5 to 7 mm. Drawn as a trunk 0.1 m in radius, rising 0.015 m a year; fronds 0.88 m long, the petiole 0.21 of them, 96 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.11 of the frond; 8 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 6 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records).

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: stems 1 to 1.5 m long, usually shorter, swollen below ground; leaves 78 to 97 cm long, the petiole 10 to 27 cm; leaflets in 86 to 107 pairs, 8 to 11 cm by 5 to 7 mm. The whole plant's height at 40 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 1.5 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them (the scientific name where no common name is in wide use), and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a cycad's crown of pinnate leaves on a pachycaul stem, drawn on the palm program.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: four seeds, so male and female plants both show.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: male cone oblong, 8 to 22 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: male cone 4 to 8.5 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: microsporophylls 1.5 to 2 cm long, the face 1 to 1.8 cm wide.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: male cone oblong; read as cylindrical.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: male cone densely tan felted; the colour by eye.

traits.microsporophyll_spine_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: microsporophylls 1.5 to 2 cm, the face 1 to 1.8 cm wide, with an upward spine 1 to 1.5 mm.

traits.megasporophyll_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: megasporophylls 6.5 to 12.5 cm long.

traits.megasporophyll_crown.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: megasporophylls in a closed crown.

traits.megasporophyll_margin.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: lamina 3 to 8 cm by 3 to 7 cm, deeply divided into 18 to 22 pairs of lobes 0.5 to 1.5 cm long, and an apical segment 1.5 to 3 cm; read as pectinate.

traits.megasporophyll_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: megasporophylls felted orange-brown; the colour by eye.

traits.ovules_per_megasporophyll.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: 1 or 2 ovules.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: seeds globose to ovoid, 2.7 to 2.9 cm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: seeds 2.2 to 3 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: sarcotesta yellow to brownish yellow when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 147), Cycas siamensis: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
